title: System Test Specialist - IEC 61850
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The System Testing Engineer is a specialist\-level individual contributor responsible for executing and driving advanced system testing activities for substation automation and protection systems. This role centers on IEC 61850 (Edition 2\.1\), top\-down engineering, and multi\-vendor relay interoperability, with a modern mandate to integrate AI\-agentic workflows into the testing lifecycle.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Core Focus: Test Strategy \& Execution
   

  

* Test Case Design: Architect comprehensive, high\-coverage test suites for complex protection and control logic.
* Automation Scripting: Develop and maintain robust automation scripts to enhance test cycle speed and consistency.
* Defect Tracking: Perform rigorous defect lifecycle management, from identification and root cause analysis to final validation.


 AI\-Driven Testing Workflow \& Skills
   

  

* Requirements to Tests: Generate accurate test cases and automation scripts directly from technical requirements using AI\-powered tools.
* Validation: Review and validate AI\-generated automation scripts for accuracy, maintainability, and standard compliance.
* Defect Intelligence: Utilize AI\-driven tools for automated defect triage, trend analysis, and comprehensive summarization of complex system issues.
* Exploratory Testing: Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to conduct AI\-guided exploratory testing to uncover edge\-case defects.


 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Troubleshooting: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for IEC 61850 inquiries. Perform deep\-dive analysis of communication logs (GOOSE, MMS, SV) and relay event records to resolve multi\-vendor integration challenges.
* Technical Collaboration: Review communication matrices and SCL configurations to identify design gaps early.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed, audit\-ready test evidence and documentation for project certification and delivery.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Domain Expertise: 3 to 6 years deep hands\-on experience with IEC 61850 (Edition 2 \& 2\.1\) and substation automation/protection systems.
* Integration Skills: Proven experience in testing and troubleshooting systems with multi\-vendor IEDs/Relays.
* Automation \& Scripting: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Shell, or similar) and experience with test automation frameworks.
* AI Competency: Demonstrated ability to apply AI based tools for test design, script generation, and defect analysis. Strong command of prompt engineering to drive technical workflows.
* Analytical Ability: Exceptional skill in log analysis, protocol trace interpretation, and root\-cause identification.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Background in power systems, protection and control, or digital substation engineering.
* Experience with SCL engineering and IEC 61850 system configuration tools.
* Experience managing complex test environments and high\-volume defect tracking in a specialist capacity.
